verdict.rationale: Conductor supports a workable debugging loop. You can spin up an isolated workspace directly from a GitHub or Linear issue, each with its own terminal and diff. Agents can test repos and run builds unattended, failing-check logs are surfaced, checkpoints let you revert to earlier states, and ⌘⇧F searches file contents. Root-cause analysis itself is left to the underlying agents rather than being a first-class Conductor capability. Missing for 10: dedicated reproduction or debugging tooling (debugger, log/trace inspection), explicit root-cause narrowing features, a documented fix-verification workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of debugging use.
